author: Async0x42
message: Fix Issue #2, Error: setup script specifies an absolute path
problem: The extension source list is built with absolute paths. The commit message reports that setup rejects this form and identifies issue #2.
reasoning: Replaces `os.path.abspath` with `os.path.relpath(..., start=os.path.dirname(__file__))`, making each discovered C/C++/CUDA source path relative to the setup-script directory. The os.walk traversal and extension filters are unchanged. This targets packaging-path representation, not compiler source selection.
impact: Changes how extension sources are passed into package building. The specific environment and full error report cannot be reconstructed from the eligible issue content.
source_notes: Retrieved 2026-11-09: https://github.com/turboderp-org/exllamav3/issues/2 and its comments endpoint. Issue creation precedes the 2025-04-07T02:44:41Z cutoff, but updated_at is later; the body was conservatively excluded because its as-of text cannot be verified through this API. No comments survived the cutoff. Cached filtered metadata: data/sources/000009-issue2.json. The commit message itself is the source for the reported error.
confidence: High for the path transformation. No wheel build was executed. The issue API updated_at can change for reasons other than body edits, so exclusion is deliberately conservative rather than proof the body changed.
